boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Gonzaga rituals spanning the Kennel, residence halls, student performances, dining, and seasonal gatherings.

cards.title: Listen for DJ DeSmet
cards.subtitle: A DeSmet Hall resident supplies Bulldog Alley’s soundtrack
cards.notes: Walk through Bulldog Alley and listen for the student DJ broadcasting music from DeSmet Hall’s third floor; timing and playlist vary.
cards.short_summary: A residence-hall DJ turns the center of campus into an open-air listening session.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga describes DJ DeSmet as a long-standing campus tradition in which a DeSmet Hall resident plays music from the third floor for campus listeners.
cards.access_notes: This informal tradition has no posted public schedule; listen from outdoor Bulldog Alley without entering the residence hall.

cards.title: Pitch In at Kennel Campout
cards.subtitle: Students camp overnight before selected basketball games
cards.notes: Secure the required game ticket, form a registered tent group, and follow Kennel Club instructions before bringing camping gear to the designated lawn.
cards.short_summary: Rows of tents transform a campus lawn into the student section’s overnight staging ground.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga says the student rite of passage began in 2006, was renamed Kennel Campout in 2022, and places registered tent groups on Foley or Herak Lawn before selected games.
cards.access_notes: Participation requires a ticket for the designated game and compliance with current registration, weather, conduct, and tent-check rules; the posted schedule is TBD.

cards.title: Wait for the 12:15 Reveal
cards.subtitle: A surprise campus location determines tent order
cards.notes: Join only through the official Kennel Campout process, keep the signed registration form ready, and travel safely to the announced location.
cards.short_summary: One scheduled social-media post triggers a campuswide hunt for numbered tent positions.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga documents that Kennel Club announces a surprise campus location at 12:15 p.m.; arriving groups receive numbers that set their camp and Kennel entry order.
cards.access_notes: Restricted to the announced Kennel Campout process. A tent number does not provide a game ticket, and participants are directed to proceed safely.

cards.title: Finish with a COG Cookie
cards.subtitle: The Hemmingson dining hall’s documented campus dessert ritual
cards.notes: Look for the cookie while dining at the COG in Hemmingson Center; confirm current meal-access and guest-payment rules before visiting.
cards.short_summary: A dining-hall cookie has become recognizable enough to earn its own place in Gonzaga tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga’s Office of Admission identifies the COG cookie as a beloved campus tradition served as dessert in the COG dining hall inside Hemmingson Center.
cards.access_notes: The cookie is inside a university dining venue; current dining access, availability, meal-plan rules, and guest payment requirements apply.

cards.title: Play the Freshmen Games
cards.subtitle: A first-year-only, four-sport intramural sequence
cards.notes: Watch first-year recreation announcements early in the academic year, then register for the listed softball, volleyball, soccer, or flag-football events.
cards.short_summary: New Zags meet through a tournament reserved for the opening months of their first year.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga documents the Freshmen Games as an experience exclusive to first-year students during their first few months, featuring four intramural sports.
cards.access_notes: Participation is limited to eligible first-year Gonzaga students and depends on current intramural registration and event rules.

cards.title: Catch Den After Dark
cards.subtitle: Student musicians take over the Hemm Den
cards.notes: Check the current student-life calendar before heading to Hemmingson’s basement for a student-band or solo performance in the Hemm Den.
cards.short_summary: A basement coffeehouse setting gives Gonzaga performers a recurring midweek stage.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga identifies Den After Dark as a campus tradition and recurring music series in the Hemm Den featuring student musicians and bands.
cards.access_notes: The 2025 university account says performances occurred most Wednesdays, but visitors should verify the current calendar, venue access, and admission rules.

cards.title: Move with Zombie Nation
cards.subtitle: The Kennel’s synchronized pre-tipoff dance
cards.notes: Take your place in the student section before tipoff, observe the nearby rows, and join the synchronized movement without blocking aisles.
cards.short_summary: The Kennel becomes a coordinated field of motion immediately before basketball begins.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga documents Zombie Nation as a synchronized dance performed by the student section before every tipoff in the Kennel.
cards.access_notes: Requires admission to an applicable basketball game and access to the student section; follow arena ticketing, seating, and safety policies.

cards.title: Enter Crimont Haunted House
cards.subtitle: Residence-hall students build a Halloween walkthrough
cards.notes: Watch official fall announcements for the student-organized event, then follow the published entry route and residence-hall access instructions.
cards.short_summary: Crimont residents temporarily remake their hall as a student-built Halloween attraction.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga says Crimont Residence Hall residents organize and stage a haunted house every fall around Halloween for students from across campus.
cards.access_notes: Crimont is a residence hall; enter only during an officially announced event and follow current guest, accessibility, and housing rules.

cards.title: Gather for Candlelight
cards.subtitle: Gonzaga’s choirs close the year in song
cards.notes: Check the Music Department’s seasonal listing, reserve admission if required, and arrive before the combined choirs begin the candlelit program.
cards.short_summary: Multiple Gonzaga vocal ensembles converge for a longstanding seasonal performance.
cards.evidence_claim: Gonzaga describes its Candlelight Concert as a longstanding tradition involving the Treble Choir, Glee Club, Concert Choir, and Big Bing Theory.
cards.access_notes: Seasonal event details, admission requirements, venue, and accessibility arrangements may change; consult the current university event listing.

cards.title: Cheer at the Watch Party
cards.subtitle: Students gather when the Zags play away from Spokane
cards.notes: Find the university’s current tournament announcement, confirm the official screening site, and arrive in time for the shared game broadcast.
cards.short_summary: An official campus gathering recreates game-day energy when tournament play happens elsewhere.
cards.evidence_claim: In a 2025 university feature, a current student described Gonzaga’s March Madness watch parties as a tradition attended every year during her time at the school.
cards.access_notes: Tournament participation and watch-party locations vary by year; verify the current official announcement, eligibility, capacity, and admission terms.

warnings: DJ DeSmet has no published schedule, and the official Kennel Campout page currently lists its schedule as TBD.
Recurring event dates, eligibility, admission, and residence-hall access should be reconfirmed through current Gonzaga announcements.
